# Test the declarative sync repository configuration lifecycle.
# Verifies init, secret set/list, bootstrap (pull-only), plan (no writes),
# doctor (drift), and that plaintext never leaks into runtime config or output.

# init vault
exec pinax init vault --title Repo --json
stdout '"command":"vault.init"'

# init sync repo declaration
exec pinax sync repo init --backend-kind s3-direct --endpoint s3://test-bucket/repo --workspace personal --tenant t1 --app pinax --credential-id tencent-cos-pinax --encryption-key-id personal-sync-key --remote-delete-policy deny --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.init"'
stdout '"status":"success"'
stdout '"workspace_id":"personal"'
stdout '"encryption_key_id":"personal-sync-key"'
! stdout 'PLAINTEXT'
! stdout 'password'
! stdout 'secret_key'

# secret set (encrypted)
exec pinax sync repo secret set --name personal-sync-key --kind encryption_key --value plain-key-value --provider fake --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.secret"'
stdout '"status":"success"'
! stdout 'plain-key-value'

# secret list (metadata only)
exec pinax sync repo secret list --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.secret"'
stdout '"count":"1"'
! stdout 'plain-key-value'

# bootstrap a new device (pull-only)
exec pinax sync repo bootstrap --device desktop-1 --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.bootstrap"'
stdout '"status":"success"'
stdout '"device_id":"desktop-1"'
stdout '"pull_only":"true"'

# plan must not write and must report drift state
exec pinax sync repo plan --device desktop-1 --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.plan"'
stdout '"runtime_configured":"true"'

# doctor after bootstrap should be healthy (declaration == runtime)
exec pinax sync repo doctor --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.repo.doctor"'
stdout '"code":"healthy"'

# runtime config must not contain the plaintext key
exec sh -c 'grep -q plain-key-value vault/.pinax/cloud/config.yaml && exit 1 || exit 0'
